priorFindings.description: The managed dialog BlocksInput early return suspends the system menu and clears systemMenuRoot without capturing its pause FocusName. On dialog cancel GameplayPauseView restores the retreat button, but on the next frame the parent menu rebinds with stale pauseFocus, commonly ResumeButton, overriding the restored selection.
priorFindings.recommendation: Preserve the pause menu focus when entering managed dialog blocking, or explicitly prefer the restored selection at rebind; retain same-frame dialog-close input blocking.
priorFindings.status: Static control-flow finding; native reproduction/test pending
